paper.title: Get Experience from Practice: LLM Agents with Record & Replay
paper.central_claim: 将成功轨迹编译成多层可复用经验和check functions，后续重放兼顾泛化、安全、隐私与效率。

provenance.notes: 按派发会话 gpt-6.1-sol 执行；没有可独立绑定的实际模型回执/session记录，依模板置null，不额外探测。

sections_read: 完整正文§1–7，含§5完整表单案例、§6全部局限
Tables1–2与Figures1–4文本/图注；全文无附录，manifest无页图

evidence.quote: This phase transforms one or more raw execution traces into a generalized, reusable experience graph.
evidence.support_explanation: 明确可留存复用的非权重轨迹编译组件。

evidence.quote: the system first replays the recorded traces to verify their reproducibility.
evidence.support_explanation: 存在执行反馈准入/诊断，不只是无变化的通用agent框架。

evidence.quote: Low-Level Experience typically consists of a series of API calls or executable scripts
evidence.support_explanation: 低层经验是可执行组件。

evidence.quote: the system falls back to High-Level Experience for task execution,
evidence.support_explanation: 低层失效时采用高层计划；给出概念回退。

evidence.quote: Once the user audits and places trust in the given check functions,
evidence.support_explanation: 安全主张依赖可信检查器及用户审计假设，不是已证安全保证。

evidence.quote: requires approximately three minutes to process this form,
evidence.support_explanation: 仅给CUA近似时间和未完成叙述，未给AgentRR实测时间/成本/试验分母。

evidence.quote: the user records two traces, trace A fills the form fields in sequential order; trace B fills out of order.
evidence.support_explanation: 仅双轨迹演示；不是统计性能评测。

evidence.quote: there is still a lack of clear definitions for different levels of experiences.
evidence.support_explanation: 多层抽象算法仍不确定。
作者明确否认现有重放完全可靠，限制绝对安全措辞。
文中承认层次记忆重放近邻。

evidence.quote: the system incrementally refines its experience repository
evidence.support_explanation: 持续改进是设计目标；无纵向重复任务收益实验。

evidence.quote: or a natural language description coupled with a validation model.
evidence.support_explanation: 检查器可以是模型；不能由TCB命名推断健全性。

signatures.object: 高层自然语言经验、低层参数化API/脚本及关联检查器
signatures.information: 已记录人类/agent动作、环境状态、任务描述；重放错误诊断
signatures.operation: 记录→重放验证→LLM总结共性/变量/约束→存储→新任务绑定参数重放
signatures.conditions: 重复任务、可记录状态、足够可靠的LLM抽象与用户审核检查器
signatures.feedback: 记录重放可复现性；失败定位诊断
signatures.selection_rule: 有效轨迹进入总结；选最低但足够成功的经验层级，失败回退高层
signatures.selection_data: 原轨迹和复现测试；没有独立选择/测试协议
signatures.persistence: experience store；跨用户分享为设想，版本/去重/废弃规则未落实
signatures.later_use: 新表单请求重放；具体成功率和分离评测未报告
signatures.claimed_effect: 更可靠、更快、更低成本和更隐私
signatures.failure_boundary: 动态元素定位失败，保守泛化与安全冲突，检查器信任依赖人工

gap.author_gap: 通用agent可靠性/隐私/成本/速度不足，精确重放难泛化，单层计划难兼顾安全与泛化
